sentences.text: This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioner/Accused No.1 in FIR.No.216 of 2019 dated 27.07.2019 on the file of Tenali Rural Police Station, Guntur District.

entities.text: Tenali Rural Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The offences alleged are under Sections 420, 270, 272, 273, 188, 328 IPC and Sections 56, 57 (1) and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
This Court has heard Sri N.Srihari, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor for respondent- State.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in a similar case, this Court, by virtue of common order in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein by considering that transportation of Gutka is not attracted by the offences alleged under Sections 188, 270 and 273 of IPC and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A perusal of the order shows that this Court, by considering that transportation of Gutka does not attract the offences alleged, quashed the proceedings.

Hence, following the said order and in terms thereof, the criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner-Accused No.1 in FIR.No.216 of 2019 dated 27.07.2019 on the file of Tenali Rural Police Station, Guntur District, are hereby quashed.
